title: Lineage & Pipeline Observability
description: Build the muscle every on-call data engineer needs: trace data through pipelines, detect freshness regressions, distinguish pipeline failures from data-quality failures, and run incident response without flying blind.
outcomes: You'll trace a metric back to its source tables, distinguish pipeline failures from data-quality failures, design freshness and SLA monitoring that catches silent regressions, and triage cascading pipeline incidents under production pressure.
